pictures.name: GSG1-Forest-Grove
pictures.prompt: A peaceful sal-tree forest grove in ancient India, soft morning light. the Buddha (shown in the traditional respectful way: serene face, short dark curls, gentle downcast eyes, a simple saffron robe over one shoulder) walks up a leafy path. Coming out to meet him from three small leaf huts are Anuruddha (a slender Indian monk of about forty, shaved head, ochre robe, a calm, clear-eyed, friendly face) and his two fellow monks (one stocky and round-faced, one tall with a thin face, both shaved heads and ochre robes): one takes his bowl, one sets out a seat, one carries water. Gold light, deep blue shade. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame.
